scope: Portraits de presets officiels MGO3, silhouettes intégrales non établies par ces plans

jobs.label: MGO3 — portrait du preset Scout au masque optique
jobs.prompt: Create exactly one isolated character portrait sprite from the attached official Metal Gear Online 3 screenshot. Reproduce only the saluting Scout avatar shown in this exact reference: olive hood/balaclava, olive multi-lens night vision mask with its exact asymmetrical lens arrangement, black over-ear radio headset and boom, beige and pale olive camouflage shoulder mantle with the same seam geometry and length, vertical brown chest straps, dark olive clothing, raised black gloved right hand saluting on image left. Faithfully preserve the face covering, proportions, colors, visible equipment, pose and 3/4 camera angle. This is a faithful reconstruction of this particular official preset screenshot, not a generic class design. Keep the EXACT waist-up framing of the reference; terminate the portrait at the same lower torso crop, do not invent legs, boots, weapons, a different mask or additional gear. Render in the restrained textured Fox Engine game appearance, not anime or painterly style. Remove ALL scenery and isolate only the single character on true transparent RGBA. No text, labels, logos, UI, border, second figure, checkerboard or floor shadow. Small transparent margins at top and sides, clean silhouette, no glow. One portrait only.

jobs.label: MGO3 — portrait du preset Enforcer au casque à visière
jobs.prompt: Create exactly one isolated character portrait sprite from the attached official Metal Gear Online 3 screenshot. Preserve the complete helmet and saluting hand within small transparent margins.

jobs.label: MGO3 — portrait du preset Infiltrator à cagoule

Reconstruct only this specific saluting Infiltrator avatar: close fitting dark olive-black knitted balaclava with two separate oval eye openings and a visible center nose ridge, brown eyes, black padded shoulders, charcoal sculpted chest armor with angular symmetrical seams and diagonal torso lacing, olive-gray upper sleeves, black forearm covering and black glove raised in salute on image left.
